acceptance: Local Parquet published-results bundles affected by the 122,880-row-group streaming Parquet layout change (DataFusion, local Spark, LakeSail) are re-run with non-null data_generation_hash stamping the final parquet_writer identity recorded by datagen-p1-parquet-semantic-fixes and parquet_row_group_size=122880 and submitted via PR against published-results.

Cloud Parquet bundles (BigQuery, Databricks, Snowflake; 9 bundles as of 2026-11-24) are explicitly documented as pre-re-baseline single-row-group layout (separated by data_generation_hash) with zero unapproved live-cloud spend, to be refreshed on their next scheduled cloud cycle.

Explorer / corpus comparability checks distinguish pre-re-baseline single-row-group Parquet runs from post-re-baseline 122,880-row-group runs via data_generation_hash with no silent apples-to-oranges mixing.
context:

Baseline audit of origin/published-results on 2026-11-24 found 89 of 496 bundles referencing Parquet (DataFusion: 69, Spark: 7, LakeSail: 3, BigQuery: 3, Databricks: 3, Snowflake: 3, unknown: 1).

2026-11-25: added needs on datagen-p1-deterministic-parquet-writer and datagen-p1-parquet-semantic-fixes so the corpus is re-baselined once, on the final writer identity. Acceptance's parquet_writer value 'benchbox-streaming' is superseded by whatever identity the semantic-fixes item records.

Owner decisions 2026-11-26 (dialog): (1) PyPI: owner sets up Trusted Publishing once; the agent then tags and publishes 0.x releases when a stage merges and BenchBox needs it. (9) Retirement: after all cutovers plus one minor release, remove dbgen/dsdgen and legacy Python generators (qgen/dsqgen under adversarial review). (10) Feature batches: A library TPC; B BenchBox integration; C SSB + 8 synthetic in parallel; D cutovers + re-baseline; E Parquet semantics + DuckLake convert in parallel with A; F retirement.
description:
## Problem
Adopting 122,880 rows/row-group as the default Parquet layout in `datagen-p1-streaming-parquet-converter` (owner Option 1 approval, 2026-11-24) changes Parquet-scan query timings by ~2.5x-6x relative to historical single-row-group Parquet files, per `docs/internal/adr/adr-benchbox-datagen.md`.

## Change
- Re-count Parquet-using bundles on `origin/published-results` at execution time.
- Re-run affected local Parquet suites (`DataFusion`, local `Spark`, `LakeSail`) using the streaming 122,880-row-group Parquet converter once `bundle-data-generation-hash-missing-from-corpus` ensures every bundle exports `data_generation_hash`.
- Submit refreshed local bundles via PR to `published-results`.
- Record the remaining cloud Parquet bundles (`BigQuery`, `Databricks`, `Snowflake`) as pre-re-baseline layout (distinct `data_generation_hash`) without incurring unapproved live-cloud spend.

## Guardrails
- Heavy benchmark runs execute exclusively via `make heavy-run` (`[HEAVY-LOCK-001]`).
- Never incur live-cloud spend without explicit owner approval.
- Never edit `published-results` directly; submit through the standard PR and validation pipeline.
